name: refrigeration_co2_transcritical_booster
title: CO2 transcritical booster refrigeration system (supermarket)
summary: CO2 (R744) booster supermarket cycle: LT (13 bar, 25 kW) and MT (26 bar, 75 kW) evaporators, receiver with flash gas by-pass at 32 bar, two constant-efficiency compressors, heat-recovery heat exchanger (5 K pinch, water 30 to 55 C) and gas cooler at 57.3 bar; subcritical and transcritical operating cases.

authors: Francesco D'Ettorre and Christian Heerup (book chapter with the cycle layout and boundary conditions)
origin.course: TESPy model library co2_cycle.ipynb (commit 19425523); D'Ettorre & Heerup, 'Modelling of a commercial refrigeration system in Python' (2026), Case Study 1

verification.summary: The TESPy notebook co2_cycle.ipynb was re-run in a throw-away venv (local clone, commit 19425523): all Case Study 1 KPIs (COP 4.9428, P 25.1679 kW, Q_hrhx -24.3996 kW, flash gas 0.18966, T discharge 68.5544 C, Q_gas cooler -100.7682 kW) agree to <= 6e-11 relative; the 100 bar transcritical case to <= 2.3e-9; printed state points to 3e-4 (5-digit source print).
verification.reference: TESPy docs/model_library/co2_cycle.ipynb re-run from the local snapshot (commit 19425523, tespy 0.11.3.dev0, CoolProp 8.0.0) in work/c190/venv; work/c190/compare_with_tespy.py against the .sol
verification.notes: Full-precision KPIs: max 6e-11 (subcritical) and 2.3e-9 (transcritical, Q_gas cooler = 0 on both sides, abs diff 3.2e-7 W). Differences against the printed connection table (up to 3.2e-4) come from its 5 significant digits. Energy balance closed to 1e-10 relative.
